articles.title_en: Russian authorities immediately called the Moscow restaurant explosion a terrorist attack — then stopped talking about it
articles.lead_en: On the evening of August 1, an explosion occurred at the upscale restaurant Balzi Rossi on Kudrinskaya Square in central Moscow. Within two hours, the National Anti-Terrorism Committee officially stated that it had been a bomb explosion, and the next morning Moscow Mayor Sergey Sobyanin called what happened a terrorist attack and promised that those responsible “will definitely be found.” After that, the authorities stopped commenting on the incident altogether, with one exception: a single social media post from the Russian Embassy in Italy.

articles.title_en: 77 Russian conscripts were killed along the Kursk region border during Ukraine’s 2024 incursion. More than 30 others are still listed as missing.
articles.lead_en: At least 77 conscript soldiers died in the first months of fighting along the Kursk region border during Ukraine’s 2024 incursion, according to a joint report by iStories and Verstka. The conscripts were between 18 and 25 years old at the time of their deaths, most of them 20.

articles.title_en: A second Russian drone developer was targeted within a week. Here’s what we know about the car bombing that wounded Vladimir Tkachuk and killed his driver.
articles.lead_en: Vladimir Tkachuk, CEO of Uraldronzavod, which manufactures the Upyr FPV drone, was targeted in an assassination attempt on the evening of August 4 in Bolshoy Istok, a village in the Sverdlovsk region about 25 kilometers (about 16 miles) from Yekaterinburg. Tkachuk also created the Z channel “Povernutye na voine” (“Obsessed with War”), which has more than 660,000 subscribers.
